summary: The design needs to account for the existing flat A2UI component graph and the fact that the linked lane currently fetches whole source frames, not widget-specific server pages. The highest risks are dashboard composition, grid pagination, refresh dependency semantics, dependency locking, and production data seeding.

suggestions.title: Compose a rooted A2UI tree, not a flat widget list
suggestions.rationale: A2UI renders the component with id `root`; sibling components are only reachable through `child`/`children`. The existing linked fixture uses a root `Column` referencing chart and table children, while `A2UISurface.svelte` dispatches only the root. The dashboard helper must generate a root container plus unique widget IDs, or most widgets will be silently omitted.

suggestions.title: Keep the 17k-row grid outside the normal linked-frame path
suggestions.rationale: `DataTable` binds to rows already present in the data model, `fetchSource` returns one bounded row array, and `LinkedLane` replaces an entire source frame on refresh. There is no existing DataTable event or transport contract for remote page/search requests. Implement the grid as an example-specific server-backed widget, or extend the wire contract explicitly; simply enabling grid.js server mode will not provide total counts, offsets, or request mapping.

suggestions.title: Make the dashboard helper typed and validate bindings before execution
suggestions.rationale: The current toolkit API accepts one untyped component and one source, and `_bind_component` assigns `root` by default and only converts a string KPI value into a `/rows/0/<column>` binding. A multi-widget API should define validated widget/source specs, require unique IDs and source keys, enforce the supported component set, and require an explicit aggregate column for KPIs.

suggestions.title: Define refresh at the source boundary and derive widget ownership from bindings
suggestions.rationale: The existing lane exposes `refreshAll` but no `refreshSource`; a widget refresh cannot safely accept an arbitrary slug from the browser. The implementation should resolve each widget's `/source_key/rows` binding to a descriptor, refresh that source only, and deduplicate widgets sharing a source. KPI bindings need the same mapping even though their value path is deeper than `/rows`.

suggestions.title: Do not parallelize refresh-all across dependent sources
suggestions.rationale: `LinkedLane.refreshAll()` deliberately follows dependency order because transforms can join or union sibling sources. A dashboard-specific parallel refresh is valid only for independent sources; the generic implementation should retain dependency-aware scheduling and in-flight deduplication, otherwise joined data can combine fresh and stale frames nondeterministically.

suggestions.title: Update every resolver and lock the actual QuerySource version
suggestions.rationale: Core still declares `querysource>=4.1.11`, tools declare `>=5.1.1`, and `uv.lock` resolves 5.1.1. Raising only the core extra to `>=5.1.2` will not make the workspace deterministic and leaves the integrations extra inconsistent. Regenerate the lockfile and align all extras, then add a startup/version test rather than relying only on a runtime warning.

suggestions.title: Treat grid.js as an unresolved asset dependency
suggestions.rationale: The repository’s grid.js catalog entry points to a CDN and contains placeholder SRI hashes; it is not a vendored runtime asset comparable to ECharts. The example must either vendor a verified, license-compatible bundle and CSS or establish a locked asset-fetch/build step with real hashes and CSP coverage before claiming the runtime is self-contained.

suggestions.title: Add contract tests for pie slice shape and dashboard reachability
suggestions.rationale: The current ECharts standard series builder emits scalar values for every chart type, while pie charts require `{name, value}` slices. Add a regression test asserting exact pie/donut slice objects, including the NULL bucket label, and an envelope test that renders all eight widgets through the rooted component tree and verifies every source binding is reachable.

suggestions.title: Move course-slug creation out of application startup
suggestions.rationale: `QuerysourceToolkit.build_linked_surface` describes and executes existing slugs but does not provide a slug-seeding contract. Creating a production `public.queries` row during aiohttp startup couples demo availability to a database write and can create race conditions across workers. Use an explicit idempotent seed/migration command, verify the resulting slug before serving, and make startup read-only.

suggestions.title: Add the exact example whitelist and a tracked-file assertion
suggestions.rationale: `.gitignore` whitelists `examples/agents/a2ui/**/*.py` but does not whitelist `examples/a2ui/`; the blanket `examples/**/*.py` and `examples/**/*.html` rules will ignore the proposed files. Add narrowly scoped exceptions for the new directory and test with `git check-ignore` in the example validation.
